rule: Only Weather Mother is presented as a work platform.
navigation: Rain, Snow, Fog, Cloud, Storm and future weather systems remain modules below Weather Mother and are reached through the persistent small Weather Mother pull drawer.
directModuleBehavior: Legacy or convenience module paths must return the user to the unified Weather Mother shell with the requested module selected.
branding: A module may display its short module name inside the shell. It must not present itself as a separate Mother or a separate public platform.
quality: Each module keeps independent visual and production gates. A shared shell never implies that an unfinished module is approved.
